# validate() function

Asserts that a string is a valid address of either family.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function validate(ip: string): void;
```

## Exceptions

## Remarks

The throwing counterpart of [isValid()](/api/net/latest/net.isvalid/)<!-- -->, used internally before conversion. Prefer [isValid()](/api/net/latest/net.isvalid/) when a bad address is an expected input rather than a programming error.
